data.body:
**[P1] Bind the actual user-handler worker before it logs**

`on_invocation_start` claims the Lambda wrapper thread, but `durable_execution` runs the user handler on a newly created pool thread, which does not inherit this `ContextVar`. With overlapping invocations, `len(_open_invocations) > 1`, so ordinary top-level logs emitted before the first durable-operation hook take this `None` path and lose correlation. Run the user future under a copied context or explicitly bind around the handler call, and test two overlapping decorated handlers whose first statement logs.
